subject.title: [Bug]: docs/tools/exec says host=node override is allowed from auto, but runtime rejects it

question: Should sandbox-backed `tools.exec.host=auto` allow per-call `host=node`, or should the docs be corrected to preserve the current fail-closed runtime boundary?
rationale: The code and docs disagree, and choosing the runtime path would change a command-execution sandbox boundary that was previously merged as security hardening.

options.title: Keep fail-closed runtime
options.body: Keep rejecting `host=node` from sandbox-backed `auto` and update the exec, approvals, and nodes docs to state that active sandboxes block host overrides.

options.title: Adopt documented node override
options.body: Allow per-call `host=node` from sandbox-backed `auto` by landing the linked runtime PR after maintainer/security approval and real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed runtime
recommendation.body: Keep rejecting `host=node` from sandbox-backed `auto` and update the exec, approvals, and nodes docs to state that active sandboxes block host overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent node-exec/Codex work and current command-execution ownership make this the best available routing candidate.
